info.name: Retrieve a Paginated List of Shift Rates

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records to return per page. For example, '10' to return up to 10 records.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting index for the records to retrieve. For example, '0' for the first page or '10' for the second page when limit=10.

items.docs:
Retrieve a paginated list of shift rates, including details such as rate name, type, value, and timestamps. Pagination parameters can be used to control the size and position of the result set.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:read`

Create a new shift rate with the specified attributes such as name, type, value, and a unique external identifier.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

info.name: Retrieve a Shift Rate by External ID

params.name: external_id
params.description: The unique external identifier of the shift rate to retrieve.

items.docs:
Retrieve details of a specific shift rate using its external ID. The response includes information such as the name, type, value, and unique identifier of the shift rate.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:read`

params.name: external_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the shift rate to be updated.

items.docs:
Update specific fields of an existing shift rate.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

info.name: Delete a Shift Rate by external ID

items.docs:
Delete a Shift Rate using its external ID, which is the custom ID provided when the shift rate is created. A ShiftRate can only be deleted if it is not currently associated with any active shift.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

Receives timesheet file metadata and generates a link to upload timesheet file. Please note that this endpoint supports EOR contracts as of now
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

params.name: timesheet_id
params.description: ID of the timesheet to fetch file for

params.name: extend
params.description: Optional list of fields to extend in the response. Currently only `file_data` is supported, which includes file details (file_id, file_name) and download URL.

items.docs:
Retrieves a timesheet by ID, including its submission, review, and processing status. When expand=file_data is provided, the response also includes file-related details such as the file name, download URL.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:read`

params.name: timesheet_id
params.description: ID of the timesheet to review

items.docs:
Review a successfully submitted timesheet. Only PENDING_REVIEW timesheets can be reviewed, and all associated hours will be approved/rejected at once.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`
